title: Rain barrel seal checklist
summary: The fittings to measure and the order to take them apart in when a barrel seal needs replacing.

# Rain barrel seal checklist

Measure the downspout outlet across its widest point before anything else, then
note the thread on the barrel inlet. Drain the barrel below the inlet, lift the
lid clear, and lay the old seal flat so its thickness can be matched in the
shop. Clean the seat with a stiff brush and a damp cloth, fit the new seal dry,
and only then tighten the nut a quarter turn past snug.
